Agentic scientific figure generation

One figure. Multiple representations.

Designed and implemented a multi-stage workflow that interpreted natural-language requests, routed them to Python/Matplotlib, TikZ, or direct-image generation, selected among candidates, and evaluated results with execution checks, visual similarity, VLM judges, and human evaluation.

More work in retrieval, computer vision & software

Local RAG with Hybrid Retrieval & Reranking

Ollama · LlamaIndex · ChromaDB · Sentence Transformers

Built a local RAG application over product documentation and historical support tickets, covering document processing, indexing, retrieval, answer generation, and evaluation with Ragas.

Benchmarked BM25, dense-embedding, hybrid, and cross-encoder reranking retrieval on a hand-labelled query set using Recall@k and MRR; quantified trade-offs between retrieval accuracy, latency, and computational cost.

Developed a Streamlit dashboard for comparing retrieval configurations side by side.

CAPTCHA Recognition

Python · PyTorch · OpenCV · CNNs · Transformers

Built a CNN–Transformer architecture with deformable convolutions and triplet attention. Placed third among eight teams in the UTN 2025 Computer Vision Challenge.

Multilingual Hate-Speech Evaluation

Python · GPT-4 · Claude · Qwen · Multilingual NLP

Built structured pipelines comparing GPT-4, Claude, and Qwen across languages, investigating differences in moderation fairness and consistency.

German Trash Classification

Python · CLIP · Computer Vision · Zero-shot Classification

Built a zero-shot waste-image classifier with CLIP and a multilingual interface. The project reported 95.4% Top-5 accuracy on its real-world evaluation data; this is not a Top-1 result.

Airline Reservation System

JavaScript · Node.js · React · MongoDB

Developed a full-stack flight-search and reservation application with a REST API using Node.js and Express, a MongoDB backend, and a React/Material UI frontend.

Implemented registration, login with encrypted password storage, flight booking, and automated email notifications via Nodemailer.

Coast Guard AI Rescue Simulation

Java · Search Algorithms · Java Swing

Built an autonomous agent navigating a dynamic sea grid with sinking ships, passenger rescue, black-box recovery, and time-dependent consequences.

Implemented eight search strategies, including BFS, DFS, iterative deepening, uniform-cost, greedy, and A*, with custom heuristics and a Swing interface for visualizing missions.

Dance Floor: Interactive 3D Application

C++ · OpenGL · 3D Graphics

Built an interactive real-time 3D environment with a controllable character, WASD movement, multiple dance animations, side, front, and free camera modes, custom mesh loading, and textured-model rendering.

ShootAliens: 2D Shooter Game

C++ · OpenGL · GLUT

Developed a complete two-level shooter with mouse-directed shooting, randomized enemy spawning, collision detection, a power-up mechanic, and timer-driven animation, progression, and win/lose states.

Autonomous Car

C/C++ · Arduino · Processing · Fritzing

Designed and built a physical autonomous vehicle; programmed motor-control and sensor-integration logic in C/C++ for an Arduino microcontroller and designed the circuit in Fritzing.

Built a Processing-based serial interface for real-time monitoring and documented the system architecture, components, and behaviour.
